They Have a Flare for a Li'l Kanga-Napping (Japanese: ハリマロン、刺す , Pierce) is the 552nd chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the fourth chapter of the .

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
attempts to have Li'l Kanga transform, but fails.
Left with no other choice, X teams up with Chespin and defeats Aliana and Mable.
X and both receive Pokédexes.
The group escapes and goes to camp out in Santalune Forest for the night.
discovers a strange stone in Kanga's pouch.
Professor Sycamore shows Lysandre the footage of the Vaniville Town incident.
